features.name: Warden at Arms
features.body: Gain Proficiencies in medium and heavy shields, as well as medium and heavy armour. Gain Proficiencies in any two Piercing or Bludgeoning weapons.

features.name: Adaptive Defense
features.body: At the start of combat and as an **Extra Action**, you may swap your **AC** and **Spell AC** values.

features.name: Defensive Spellcasting
features.body: Attacks of Opportunity against you from spellcasting are made with Disadvantage.

features.name: Signature Spells: Warden
features.body: Gain access to the Warden Signature Spells for each magic type.

features.name: Arcane Adaptation
features.body: Choose a Non-Physical damage type, you can Resistance in that damage type. Choose another Resistance at Warden Levels 5, 8, and 10. (*Non-Physical damage type are Fire, Cold, Lightning, Aether, Radiant, Entropic, Psychic, Necrotic*).

features.name: Protective Ward
features.body: Whenever you apply a buff on an ally or target an ally with a beneficial spell or ability, gain stacks of **Ward** depending on the Action cost. 2 Stacks for Full Actions and Reactions, 1 Stack for everything else. **Ward** is a *Strong Buff* that reduces the amount of damage you take from any source (*e.g. 3 stacks of Ward reduces all damage by 3*). Increase the stacks of Ward gained by **+1** at Warden Levels 6 and 9, and Player Levels 13 and 17. Whenever you take at least **1 damage** to your Health (after Ward is calculated), remove 1 Stack of ward. 2 Stacks of Ward is removed at the start of your turn. *Pure damage ignores Ward.*

features.name: Constitution Casting
features.body: You may have your Spells cast from any Crystal use **CON** instead of any of the Stats listed.
